title: Secure AI Development Act
last_action: Introduced and referred to Senate Commerce. No public markup located by the cutoff.
summary: Establishes secure pre-release testing for frontier AI, modernizes vulnerability reporting, reviews AI vulnerabilities under the federal Vulnerabilities Equities Process, and strengthens NSA AI Security Center and laboratory/system-security functions.
committee_dynamics: Warner brings intelligence and cyber credibility, but Senate Commerce has jurisdiction over the civilian standards and development provisions. The bill may move more readily as intelligence-authorization or NDAA text than as a standalone measure.
advance_rationale: Strong national-security framing and natural must-pass vehicles offset the absence of public markup and the need to coordinate Commerce and intelligence equities.

title: ELVIS Act
last_action: Signed by the Governor; assigned Public Chapter 588.
summary: Expands Tennessee's protected personal rights to include voice and strengthens remedies against unauthorized commercial exploitation of a person's name, image, likeness, or voice, including harms enabled by generative AI and synthetic media.
committee_dynamics: The measure passed both chambers unanimously and is included as a targeted synthetic-media and impersonation protection.
advance_rationale: Enacted state law.

agency_status.detail: The statute is effective and enforced through its private-rights and remedies framework; no centralized agency implementation program is specified.

verification_level: Official legislature source verified.

title: Texas Responsible Artificial Intelligence Governance Act
last_action: Effective date recorded after enactment.
summary: Creates a statewide AI governance framework with disclosure duties for specified governmental and health-care uses, prohibitions on certain harmful or unlawful development and deployment, biometric protections, civil penalties, and a state regulatory sandbox.
committee_dynamics: Texas narrowed an earlier comprehensive proposal but retained enforceable prohibited-use, disclosure, and public-sector provisions.
advance_rationale: Enacted state law.

agency_status.detail: The law is effective; this starter record has not yet completed a rulemaking and enforcement inventory.

verification_level: Official legislature history and enrolled text verified.
